name: TinyHand for GNOME
description:
A tiny hand on a stick that follows your cursor, with tap sounds, fading ink and visual settings. Point normally or capture drags in Draw mode; hold Alt to interact with apps.

Targets GNOME 45–50; 45–49 are experimental (API/mocked checks only). GNOME 50.1 is the only desktop-tested version. Settings require GTK 4.8+ and libadwaita 1.4+.

Linux port of TinyHand by Kamran Ahmed (@nilbuild): https://github.com/nilbuild/tinyhand. Original artwork, sounds and concept are credited to the upstream project. Linux port maintained by AbdulRehman56.
